```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
cat("Number of features:", length(raw$features), "\n")
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)

first_boundary_coordinate <- unlist(fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]])
first_boundary_coordinate
```

```{r}
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

wildfires
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    boundary_lng = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[1]])
    ),
    boundary_lat = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[2]])
    )
  )

fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_fires))) {
  fire_map <- addPolygons(
    fire_map,
    lng = top_fires$boundary_lng[[i]],
    lat = top_fires$boundary_lat[[i]],
    popup = paste0(
      top_fires$incident[[i]], " (",
      top_fires$fire_year[[i]], "): ",
      round(top_fires$gis_acres[[i]]), " acres"
    ),
    fillOpacity = 0.7
  )
}

fitBounds(
  fire_map,
  lng1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lng)),
  lat1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat)),
  lng2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lng)),
  lat2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat))
)
```
